review: Independent unique byte-window matches against checksum-verified stock 2168446 and native disassembly locate each new site. Module-record registers, the 0xed0 initialization field, branch destinations and loader callback registration retain their contracts. Native FName decoding confirms the relocated pool/ready globals, block offset 0x68, two-byte entry indexing and string header layout. The exported SEED_ofb128_encrypt ends with ret before 231 executable padding bytes. Changes from 2177228 are not uniform: code sites, globals and padding move differently. Detours and references are regenerated with the unchanged Tank-only generator; ordinary vehicle IDs remain native.
